svg.text: Repo layout and module dependency map. One directional flow: API → Orchestrator → Agents → Tools → External SaaS. Models & DB are cross-cutting.

g.text: Layers flow top-down. No layer imports the one above it. Models & DB are shared.
FRONTEND — AImpact Next.js app (external to this repo)
/content route · lib/api.js → fetch('/api/aca/…') with httpOnly cookie
Also: server-to-server clients hitting /api/aca/* with Bearer at_…
AGENTS · aca/agents/ — five agents · input schema → output schema · stateless
TOOLS · aca/tools/ — one file per external SaaS · retry · rate-limit
CROSS-CUTTING · aca/models/ · aca/db/ · aca/security/ · aca/observability/ · aca/config.py
Large draft artifacts · WP application passwords
